goal: Allow PSBT processing RPCs to explicitly add, preserve, or strip key-origin derivation metadata
Let participants in collaborative workflows sanitize sensitive derivation paths and xpubs before sharing
reviewability: Author has been silent for 84 days
New reviews may wait a long time for an author response
agreement: Concept and approach approval for adding strip options to PSBT processing RPCs (willcl-ark, rkrux)
Unaddressed objection: strip mode breaks MuSig2 signing on PSBTs lacking key origins (fametrano)
Open question on whether participant pubkeys should also be stripped to avoid fingerprinting (fametrano)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because users get explicit modes to add, preserve, or strip derivation metadata in PSBT RPCs
Resolves unexpected retention of derivation paths and global xpubs when processing transactions
